advisoryFindings.title: R5 retry limit is represented by manual attempts
advisoryFindings.rationale: The current test directly bounds the injected failure sequence to two calls and verifies durable effects; the remaining retry-limit preservation appears delegated to retained suites, so this is a useful strengthening rather than missing spec-local coverage.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider adding a focused assertion around the production retry-limit/config path if that behavior is not already covered by the retained gate suites.
